label: Align to faces
tooltip: Alignment to fitted faces, axes or regions by the 3-2-1 principle.
help: The primary datum sets Z (a plane or an axis), the secondary datum X or Y, the optional tertiary datum the origin. Click shapes, reference geometry or regions in the project tree or the viewport; they go into the active field. For a shaft, an axis and an end face are enough. Before OK, check the deviation of the inputs and the tilt of the largest plane.
pickHint: Click a shape, reference geometry or region in the project tree or viewport.
inputsFirst: Choose the primary and secondary datum.

problems.unknown: No longer exists or is suppressed.
problems.unsupported: Is neither a plane, an axis nor a sphere.
problems.pointAsPrimary: A sphere sets no direction; use it as the tertiary datum.
problems.staleSelection: The selection belongs to an older state of the scan.
